name: Lufthansa Miles and More® World Elite Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Lufthansa Miles and More® World Elite Mastercard®

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: The annual fee will be waived for Senator and HON Circle Members, as long as they maintain their Senator or HON Circle Member status.

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for 15 billing cycles on balance transfers within 45 days of account opening, then 19.49% to 29.49%. Cash advance APR 29.74% variable. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee 5% (min $5). Cash advance fee 5% (min $10).

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 mile per $1 spent on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem for flight tickets from the entire Lufthansa Group and Star Alliance network. Once each calendar year, you can convert 5,000 to 25,000 miles earned on purchases into Points and Qualifying Points. For example, 5,000 miles convert to 20 Points + 20 Qualifying Points.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 miles after you spend $3,000 in purchases and pay the annual fee in full, both within the first 90 days.

benefits.title: Lounge Access with Two Complimentary Lufthansa Business Lounge Vouchers
benefits.description: Receive lounge access with two complimentary Lufthansa Business Lounge Vouchers annually.

benefits.title: Annual Companion Ticket
benefits.description: Receive an Annual Companion Ticket after each account anniversary (taxes and fees apply).

benefits.title: Achieve Miles & More® Status Faster
benefits.description: Once each calendar year, you can convert 5,000 to 25,000 miles earned on purchases into Points and Qualifying Points. For example, 5,000 miles convert to 20 Points + 20 Qualifying Points.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Low Intro APR on Balance Transfers
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, a variable APR will apply, 19.49% to 29.49%.

benefits.title: Chip Technology
benefits.description: Paying for your purchases is more secure at chip-card terminals in the USA and abroad.

lounge_access.notes: Two complimentary Lufthansa Business Lounge Vouchers annually
